operations.description: Retrieve passenger trip, contact and baggage details. This service is only accessible for LH privileged partners
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] baggage trip and contact [PATH] baggage baggagetripandcontact [PARAMS] accept id search [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieves all available fares for a specific Origin & Destination pair on a given date. Available fares are: One-way and Return for 4U. Return only for OS
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all fares [PATH] offers fares allfares [PARAMS] accept cabin catalogues class date destination family fare origin return trackingid travel travelers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieve best fares for the requested journey across multiple days or multiple months.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] best fares [PATH] offers fares bestfares [PARAMS] accept cabin catalogues class country date destination duration family fare origin range trackingid travel trip [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns valid deep links for the provided input parameters
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] deep links [PATH] offers fares deeplink [PARAMS] accept cabin catalogues class country currency date destination encryption fare key lang name net origin outbound partnerid return segments trackingid travel travelers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns valid LH deep links (FFP - links to flight selection screen on LH.COM)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] lh deep links ffp [PATH] offers fares deeplink ffp [PARAMS] accept cabin catalogues class country date destination encryption key lang origin partnerid return trackingid travel travelers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns valid LH deep links (ITCO - links to shopping cart on LH.COM)
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] lh deep links itco [PATH] offers fares deeplink itco [PARAMS] accept cabin catalogues class country currency date destination encryption fare key lang net origin outbound partnerid return segments trackingid travel travelers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieve all available fares per fare family for a specific Origin & Destination on a given date
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fares [PATH] offers fares fares [PARAMS] accept carriers catalogues fare segments travelers types [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieve lowest fare for a specific Origin & Destination pair on a given date. Available fares are: One-way and Return for 4U. Return only for OS & LH
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] lowest fares [PATH] offers fares lowestfares [PARAMS] accept cabin catalogues class country date destination family fare origin return travel travelers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Create a subscription for best price O&D. Receive regular updates on lowest fares
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] fares subscriptions [PATH] offers fares subscriptions [PARAMS] accept cabin class country destination duration email lang origin trackingid trip [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns LH route origin & destination information
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ond route [PATH] offers ond route [PARAMS] accept catalogues destination limit offset origin [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns LH network route status information. Search for recently added or retired routes
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] ond status [PATH] offers ond status [PARAMS] accept catalogues new old routes [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns LH Top routes per country or across all countries
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] top ond [PATH] offers ond top [PARAMS] accept catalogues origin [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieve order by ID and optionally name. This service is only accessible for LH privileged partners
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] orders [PATH] orders orders [PARAMS] accept id name order [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Retrieve a best price offer given an origin and destination.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] price offers [PATH] promotions priceoffers flights ond [PARAMS] date departure destination origin return service [SCHEMA]

operations.description: A description of all available seat details by aircraft type. You can retrieve the full set or details for a particular aircraft type.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] seat details [PATH] references seatdetails [PARAMS] accept aircraft cabin code lang [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Trigger an automatic check-in given a ticket number. This service is only accessible for LH privileged partners
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] auto check in [PATH] preflight autocheckin [PARAMS] accept address email ticketnumber [SCHEMA]
